voiceover_script: Kya aap jaante hain ki dharti par behti pavitra Ganga nadi aakhir aayi kahan se? Ye katha hai asambhav ko sambhav banane wale ghor sankalp ki — Raja Bhagiratha aur Mahadev ke divya aashirwad ki. Puranon ke anusar, Ayodhya ke Raja Sagara ke 60,000 putron ne Kapila Muni ka apmaan kiya tha, jiske krodh se sabhi putra bhashm ho gaye the. Unki aatma ko mukti tabhi mil sakti thi jab devlok se pavitra Ganga unki raakh ko sparsh karein. Peedhiyon tak kisi raja ko safalta nahi mili. Aakhir mein Raja Bhagiratha ne apna raaj-paat chhodkar Himalaya mein hazaaron saal tak ghor tapasya ki. Brahma ji prasanna hue aur bole — 'Main Ganga ko bhej toh doon, lekin unke prachand veg ko jhelne ki shakti is poori dharti par kisi mein nahi hai! Agar Ganga seedhe dharti par giri, toh prithvi ratal mein sama jayegi. Sirf Mahadev hi unhe sambhaal sakte hain.' Bhagiratha ne phir Bhole Nath ki kathin tapasya ki. Mahadev ne muskurakar sankalp liya. Jab Ganga ghamand ke sath aakash se garajte hue dharti ki taraf daudi, tab Mahadev ne Himalaya ke shikhar par khade hokar apni jataon ko khol diya. Ganga unki jataon ke ghane bhanwar mein aise samayi ki unhe bahar nikalne ka rasta hi nahi mila! Ganga ka ahankar shant ho gaya. Tab Mahadev ne apni jata se ek kesh ko dheere se khola — aur Ganga saat pavitra dharon ke roop mein dharti par amrit ban kar bahi! Bhagiratha ke naam par hi Ganga ko Bhagirathi kaha gaya. Ye katha hume sikhati hai ki chahe raste mein kitni bhi kathinaiyan aayein, dridh sankalp aur Mahadev par vishwas se har asambhav lakshya haasil ho sakta hai. Pavitra Maa Ganga aur Mahadev ke samman mein comment mein likhein Har Har Gange aur subscribe karein Epic Bharat Saga. Om Namah Shivaya!
debate_question: Bhagiratha jaisi tapasya aur sankalp aaj ke yug mein sambhav hai?

description:
Ganga Ko Shiv Ne Apni Jataon Mein Sameta! 🌊

🔱 Ganga descent from heaven Shiva jata Bhagiratha penance

King Bhagiratha performed intense tapasya for generations to bring the celestial river Ganga from Svarga to earth to liberate the ashes of 60,000 ancestors. Brahma warned that Ganga's cosmic force would shatter the earth, so Shiva caught her torrent in his matted hair (Jata), releasing her gently as seven sacred streams.

👉 Bhagiratha jaisi tapasya aur sankalp aaj ke yug mein sambhav hai?
